dimensions.note: token is sensitive in the schema; mirror source and remote credentials and Actions secret values are write-only; runner registration token is sensitive; both transports (api.ts and the forked base's realCaller) mask a token the forge echoes back, the base one added in this version. The push-time credentials-sensitive-field warnings are the heuristic matching variable names in actions.ts and push_mirror.ts, not unmasked fields.
structured placeholders throughout; no secret in any log property.

every HTTP error carries method, path, status and the forge's message, the token check included (it no longer goes through call, and builds the same message itself); writes happen after the calls that can fail.

the 21 former add-on methods keep their strict-fake unit tests (negative paths included); checks_test.ts gained the scope-403 pass, the non-scope-403 fail and the scopeRefusal table. The forked base is covered by forgejo_test.ts for type, version, upgrade chain, method inventory, check removal, timeout fallback and token masking, all through health. The other 19 upstream methods carry no unit tests of their own, as upstream shipped none; follow-up.
every *_ensure probes first and reports created/updated/unchanged; deletes are no-ops when already gone; archive/unarchive are no-ops in the requested state.
listings paginate to a short page; search and bare-array responses both handled; response fields are read defensively; user_search is the one documented cap (50).
fetch timeouts cleared in finally; no files or handles.
README and tests use example.com, example-org and placeholder tokens; no IP literals.
every spec has lifetime and garbageCollection; userMatch is 7d, the rest infinite.
with the merge, the type now has create/converge (ensure), read (list, status, get) and verify-first delete for repositories, organizations, push mirrors and runners.

forgejo-api-url-shape (policy) and forgejo-token-accepted (live). The live check now passes a 403 whose body names a required scope: Forgejo authenticates the token before it checks scopes, so that answer proves acceptance; a 401, or a 403 for any other reason, fails with the forge's message. Unit tests cover the scope 403 (pass), a non-scope 403 (fail), the 401 and scopeRefusal itself.

the base's safeName turns / into : and PR names carry #index; the add-ons' specs are their own and do not collide with the nine base specs (asserted in forgejo_test.ts that no add-on method name shadows a base method).

the base reads nothing back. push_mirror_list's drift report lists every stored pushMirror record of the model through the optional, guarded context.dataRepository.findAllForModel, because a spec-wide listing has no single instance for readResource to name; unchanged from 2026.10.05.2 and reviewed there.
upgrades ends at 2026.10.05.4 with a no-op entry after the 2026.10.05.3 one; global arguments unchanged.
